If zero, stop; you can't take this credit"; a worksheet after a STOP counts as skipped. The case has line 7 $0.00, so f8880.past7 is false and the project now hides (CLW 1) (shown_when f8880.past7, T-067); the $0.00 in the log is the hidden internal value, requested only because the class M fill of a non-collection document ignores shown_when (T-079 (1)). The reply leaves the line blank ("Skipped; line 7 is zero, so stop"), which follows the source. The prompt (.classm/classm.f8880.1.prompt.txt) lists the line as "line (CLW 1)"; the reply names it "CLW 1" without the parentheses, and the class M parser (tools/transcription/classm.py extract) strips only a leading "line " before matching, so the log records no answer (known defect T-070 (1), T-081 (1); case classm.f8880.3 writes "(CLW n)" and was read). Not a model error and not a project defect. Expectation dropped (none was recorded).
